cause: Two native error assertions incorrectly compared Go Root.OpenRoot regular-file rejection, which is a fresh errors.New value in os.newRoot, to the O_DIRECTORY syscall errno returned by Filestore. This is an oracle mismatch, not a production bug. No string comparison is introduced.
correction: Unix native table uses independent Go Root.OpenFile with native O_DIRECTORY/NONBLOCK for exact acquisition errors. Namespace and mode oracle remains independent. Table is built for Darwin/Linux; other-platform coverage stays separately attributed.
